name: hou_mcp_import_asset
description: Import a locally-fetched asset file (USD/FBX/ABC/OBJ) into the Houdini scene via the bridge. This is the final step connecting the acquisition pipeline to the scene. Formats: usd/usda/usdc/usdz → usdimport SOP; abc → alembic SOP; fbx/obj/bgeo → file SOP.
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.utils.hou_bridge import get_bridge
import os

class Hou_Mcp_Import_Asset(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_import_asset"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("local_path",   "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("asset_id",     "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("geo_name",     "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("parent",       "string", widget_type="text", default="/obj")
        self.add_input("pos_x",        "float",  widget_type="float", default=0.0)
        self.add_input("pos_y",        "float",  widget_type="float", default=0.0)
        self.add_input("pos_z",        "float",  widget_type="float", default=0.0)
        self.add_input("uniform_scale","float",  widget_type="float", default=1.0)
        self.add_output("geo_path",  "string")
        self.add_output("sop_path",  "string")
        self.add_output("format",    "string")
        self.add_output("ok",        "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        local_path    = str(inputs.get("local_path") or "").strip()
        asset_id      = str(inputs.get("asset_id") or "").strip()
        geo_name      = str(inputs.get("geo_name") or asset_id or "asset").strip()
        parent        = str(inputs.get("parent") or "/obj").strip() or "/obj"
        pos_x         = float(inputs.get("pos_x") or 0.0)
        pos_y         = float(inputs.get("pos_y") or 0.0)
        pos_z         = float(inputs.get("pos_z") or 0.0)
        uniform_scale = float(inputs.get("uniform_scale") or 1.0)

        if not local_path:
            self.log_error("hou_mcp_import_asset: local_path is required.")
            return {"geo_path": "", "sop_path": "", "format": "", "ok": False, "exec_out": True}

        if not os.path.exists(local_path):
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_import_asset: file not found: {local_path}")
            return {"geo_path": "", "sop_path": "", "format": "", "ok": False, "exec_out": True}

        ext = local_path.rsplit(".", 1)[-1].lower()
        # Determine Houdini SOP type and parameter name for the file path
        if ext in ("usd", "usda", "usdc", "usdz"):
            sop_type  = "usdimport"
            parm_name = "filepath"
            fmt       = "usd"
        elif ext == "abc":
            sop_type  = "alembic"
            parm_name = "fileName"
            fmt       = "alembic"
        else:
            # fbx, obj, bgeo, bgeo.sc, geo — use generic file SOP
            sop_type  = "file"
            parm_name = "file"
            fmt       = ext

        # Sanitize geo name for Houdini
        safe_name = "".join(c if c.isalnum() or c == "_" else "_" for c in geo_name)[:32] or "asset"

        try:
            bridge = get_bridge()

            # Create Object-level geo container
            geo_result = bridge.create_node(parent, "geo", safe_name)
            geo_path   = geo_result["path"]

            # Remove default File SOP Houdini adds
            for child in bridge.children(geo_path):
                bridge.delete_node(child["path"])

            # Create the import SOP
            sop_result = bridge.create_node(geo_path, sop_type, "import")
            sop_path   = sop_result["path"]

            # Set the file path
            bridge.set_parm(sop_path, parm_name, local_path)

            # Set display + render flags
            bridge.set_display_flag(sop_path, True)
            bridge.set_render_flag(sop_path, True)

            # Position the object in world space
            bridge.set_parms(geo_path, {"tx": pos_x, "ty": pos_y, "tz": pos_z})
            if uniform_scale != 1.0:
                bridge.set_parms(geo_path, {"scale": uniform_scale})

            # Cook to validate
            bridge.cook_node(sop_path)

            self.log_info(f"Imported {fmt} asset '{safe_name}' → {geo_path} (from {local_path})")
            return {"geo_path": geo_path, "sop_path": sop_path, "format": fmt, "ok": True, "exec_out": True}

        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_import_asset failed: {e}")
            return {"geo_path": "", "sop_path": "", "format": fmt if 'fmt' in dir() else "", "ok": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Import_Asset
